newsitem.title: UK: BFI up three, Panamax rates mixed.
newsitem.headline: BFI up three, Panamax rates mixed.

text.p: In quiet trading conditions the Baltic Freight Index (BFI)was raised three points to 1,372 on Thursday.
Brokers reported slightly easier conditions for Panamaxes in the Far East but contuining firmness for early Panamaxes in the Atlantic.

Andre introduced a fresh enquiry for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Taiwan for July cancelling for which they were said to be bidding as much $23.50. By contrast a Tradigrain stem in this trade for early August was quoted at only $21.50.
The Baltic Handy Index was down four to 1,007.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was up 10 to 29 points in the active positions which notched up a sizeable 446 lots.
